name: zavri
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create an original, sophisticated brand-design exploration for a learning-center coordination app. The user rejected a previous set because every option looked like the same blue car-company monogram. This new direction must have its own character and be immediately different. The app brings attendance, students, instructors, daily work and progress together; the logo can communicate a feeling instead of illustrating every feature. Draw actual usable logo artwork, not just mood-board photographs. Flat graphic design, accurate words, beautiful optical spacing and purposeful proportions. No metallic badges, shields, monograms, slanted racing letters, chrome, bevels, glossy effects, gradients, 3D, fake embossed stationery, corporate navy/blue palette, generic letter-in-a-square icon, school caps, open books, gears, circuit nodes, AI sparkles or infinity symbols. No third-party logos or imitation of a named company's identity. Show one main original logo, a simple standalone symbol, and a small convincing app-corner sample with that SAME identity. That corner sample should only have the brand header and two navigation labels: 'Home' and 'Students'. Use no student records, invented features, slogan, explanation, lorem ipsum or tiny body text. This is a creative identity study, so all marks, type and colors must look deliberately art-directed. DIRECTION: WARM, PLAYFUL, CONTEMPORARY. Square editorial canvas dominated by warm coral #E65343 with generous warm buttercream #FFF1D8 areas and small burgundy #4C2432 accents. Brand wordmark exactly 'zavri', lowercase z-a-v-r-i, drawn with chunky soft rounded letterforms, generous curves and a slight human unevenness. Friendly and confident, not bubbly kindergarten type. Original symbol: four rounded asymmetrical pebble-like petals huddling around a small off-center open space; a lively organic gathering shape, not a letter or a gear. Use this organic gathering mark in burgundy beside the large buttercream wordmark across the coral field. Lower portion contains an off-white app corner sample with a burgundy wordmark and small coral gathering symbol; broad rounded navigation highlight. Include the small solid one-color burgundy symbol on cream elsewhere. The feeling is a lively community product with sophisticated graphic design. Do NOT use geometric grotesk letters, straight-line mechanical constructions or a sterile white presentation board. The silhouette should feel soft, social and memorable.
